question_text: Nimal has an RSA public key (n, e) = (33, 3) and a private key = (n, d) = (33, 7). Kamal has an RSA public key (n, e) = (91, 11) and a private key = (n, d) = (91, 59). Suppose Kamal encrypts a plain text message M=2 to Nimal. Nimal receives cipher text message C=4.
student_answer: True. Kamal encrypts a plain text message by Nimal's RSA public key. $$\text{Cipher text} = (e_(kamal) - d_(nimal)) \times M = ((11 - 7) \times 2) = 4 \times 2 = 8$$
